title: yancc: A GPU-accelerated, differentiable solver for neoclassical transport in tokamaks and stellarators
summary: We present yancc, a new GPU-accelerated solver for the drift kinetic equation that computes neoclassical transport fluxes, flows, and currents in tokamaks and stellarators. The drift kinetic equation is challenging to solve numerically due to strong advection-dominance, recirculating flows, internal boundary layers, severe anisotropy, and high dimensionality. The code solves both the full four-dimensional drift kinetic equation (retaining speed-dependent collisions, energy scattering, and full interspecies coupling), and the reduced monoenergetic form.
